mapper.insert: insert into inventory_reservation(order_no, sku_id, sku_num, status) values (#{orderNo}, #{skuId}, #{skuNum}, #{status})
mapper.select: select count(*) from inventory_reservation where order_no = #{orderNo} and is_deleted = 0
select id, order_no, sku_id, sku_num, status, create_time, update_time, is_deleted from inventory_reservation where order_no = #{orderNo} and is_deleted = 0 order by sku_id for update
